label: SIMULATED — not a measured clinical or API result

assumptions.baseline: Uniform arrivals during a 90-minute morning cluster
assumptions.scheduled: 12-minute scheduled spacing with normal arrival jitter, SD 8 minutes, clamped to 0
assumptions.service: Identical paired lognormal consultation durations, mean 12 minutes, log-space SD 0.35
assumptions.policy: Non-preemptive FIFO by arrival in both scenarios; one clinician per queue
assumptions.exclusions: No urgent cases, breaks, no-shows, bed effects or patient outcomes; no calibration to real hospitals
